I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation do hereby declare under Sub- section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

Allotments of land depicted in below names and extents in the Advance Tracing No. Gm/JAE/2023/221 dated 21.09.2023 prepared by the Surveyor General situated in the Village called Peralanda in No. 181D, Peralanda Grama Niladhari Division in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Ja- Ela in Gampaha District of the Western Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ - Delgahawatta - Extent: 0.0159 Hectare North: Railway reservation and Delgahawatta land claimed by Shamalee Resairo and others; East: Railway reservation and Lot B (Ela); South: Lot B (Ela) and road; West: Road and Delgahawatta land claimed by Shamalee Resairo and others.

02. Lot ‘B’ - Not known - Extent: 0.0017 Hectare North: Lot A and Railway reservation; East: Lot C and Railway reservation; South: Lot C and Road; West: Road and Delgahawatta land claimed by Shamalee Resairo and others.

03. Lot ‘C’ - Delgahawatta - Extent: 0.0241 Hectare North: Lot B (Ela) and Railway reservation; East: Delgahawatta land claimed by H.D. Sudaraka and Railway reservation; South: Delgahawatta land claimed by H.D. Sudaraka and Road; West: Road and Lot No. B (Ela). K.D. Lൺඅ Kൺඇඍඁൺ, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation.
